description: Source code for the SoundPool class and related classes in Android's media framework, managing sound sample loading, playback, and channel control.

classes.name: SoundPool
classes.description: Manages multiple sound samples and channels, handles loading, playing, pausing, stopping, and thread management.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Represents an audio sample, handles decoding and data management.

classes.name: SoundChannel
classes.description: Represents a playback channel for a sound sample, manages audio track lifecycle and playback controls.

classes.name: SoundEvent
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for scheduled sound playback events.

methods.name: SoundPool::load
methods.description: Loads a sound sample from a file path or file descriptor.

methods.name: SoundPool::play
methods.description: Starts playback of a loaded sample on an available channel.

methods.name: SoundPool::stop
methods.description: Stops playback on a specific channel.

methods.name: SoundPool::setVolume
methods.description: Sets volume for a specific channel.

methods.name: SoundPool::setRate
methods.description: Adjusts playback rate for a channel.

methods.name: Sample::doLoad
methods.description: Decodes and loads sample data into memory.

methods.name: SoundChannel::play
methods.description: Initializes and starts playback of a sample on a channel.
